  - `receptor_mitigation_frontier(H, W, thresholds, options, budget, weights=None, z=1.96)`：枚举预算内每受体选一方案的非支配缓解方案前沿。`options`/`budget` 契约及 `TypeError`/`ValueError` 与 `receptor_mitigation_plan` 相同（外层/分组非序列抛 `TypeError`，长度不符、空分组、项非二元抛 `ValueError`，`r`、`c`、`budget` 类型错抛 `TypeError`，非有限或负抛 `ValueError`）；五参与 `receptor_excess_interval` 同契约。对每种组合，`C=fsum(c_i)≤budget` 时令 `H′[k][i]=H[k][i]−r_i`，调用 `receptor_excess_interval(H′, W, thresholds, weights, z)` 得 `(M,R,L,U)`，`S=fsum(max(U[i][j],0))`、`D=fsum(R[i][j])`、`G=Σ[L[i][j]>0]`（`i<N, j<3`）。仅保留在 `(S,D,G,C)` 上逐项 `≤` 且至少一项严格更小的方案不被任何其他方案支配者；无可行组合抛 `ValueError`。返回按 `(S,D,G,C,choice)` 升序排列的 list，每项为 `(choice, C, S, D, G, (M,R,L,U))`，`choice` 为 N 长 0 基选项下标的 `list[int]`，均不舍入
  - `policy_recommend(H, W, thresholds, quantiles, policies, options, budget, weights=None, z=1.96)`：为每个非支配缓解方案搭配最优运行预警策略。除 `quantiles`、`policies` 外，参数约束与每种错误条件的异常类型沿用 `receptor_mitigation_frontier`；二者沿用 `receptor_count_run_policy_batch`（故 K≥2）。令 `F=receptor_mitigation_frontier(H,W,thresholds,options,budget,weights,z)`；对其中 `(choice,C,S,D,G,interval)`，构造 `H′[k][i]=H[k][i]−options[i][choice[i]][0]`，以 `H′` 代替 `H` 调用批量函数得 `(results,scores,order)`，令 `p=order[0]`、`o=results[p]`、`a=max(o[1])`、`s=scores[p]`。返回各 `(choice,p,C,S,D,G,a,s,interval,o)` 组成的 list，按 `(S,D,G,C,−a,−s,choice,p)` 升序；内部类型、形状沿既有返回，数值不舍入
  - `robust_policy_summary(H, W, thresholds, quantiles, policies, options, budget, weight_sets, z=1.96)`：在多组情景权重下稳健地挑选预算内的缓解方案与运行预警策略（仅自 `air_quality.health` 导出，不入包根）。除 `weight_sets` 外，参数约束与每种错误条件的异常类型沿用 `policy_recommend`（故 K≥2）。`weight_sets` 为非空 L×K list/tuple 矩阵，元素为非 bool 有限非负数，各行 `fsum>0` 后按 `fsum` 归一；容器/行/元素类型错抛 `TypeError`，空、锯齿、行长不等于 K、非有限、负值或行零和抛 `ValueError`。枚举每个预算内 `(choice,p)`（`choice` 为每受体各选一选项且成本 `C=fsum(c_i)≤budget`，`p` 遍历全部策略）：构造 `H′[k][i]=H[k][i]−options[i][choice[i]][0]`，对每权重行 `w` 调用 `receptor_excess_interval(H′,W,thresholds,w,z)` 得 `I=(M,R,L,U)`，按 `p` 的策略参数调用 `receptor_count_run_warning` 得 `o`。令 `S=fsum(max(U[i][j],0))`、`D=fsum(R[i][j])`、`G=Σ[L[i][j]>0]`（`i<N, j<3`）、`a=max(o[1])`、`s=fsum(o[4][K−1])`；对每一权重行，所有 `(choice,p)` 按 `(S,D,G,C,−a,−s,choice,p)` 升序赋 0 基名次，`ranks` 收齐该对的 L 个名次。取 `(max(ranks),fsum(ranks),choice,p)` 最小者，返回 `(choice,p,ranks,metrics,intervals,o)`：`choice` 为 N 长 0 基选项下标 `list[int]`，`p` 为 int，`ranks` 为 L 长 `list[int]`，`metrics` 含 L 个 `(S,D,G,C,a,s)`，`intervals` 含 L 个 `(M,R,L,U)`，`o` 沿 `receptor_count_run_warning` 既有结构，数值不舍入；无可行组合抛 `ValueError`
  - `robust_policy_report(H, W, thresholds, quantiles, policies, options, budget, weight_sets, z=1.96)`：多组情景权重下稳健方案与预警策略的 JSON 兼容摘要（仅自 `air_quality.health` 导出，不入包根）。参数约束与每种错误条件的异常类型沿用 `robust_policy_summary`，异常原样传播。仅调用 `robust_policy_summary` 一次取 `(choice,p,ranks,metrics,intervals,o)`，返回键依次为 `choice`、`policy`、`robustness`、`weights`、`warning` 的 dict：`choice` 为 `choice` 的 list 副本，`policy` 为 `p`；`robustness` 为 `[max(ranks), fsum(ranks), list(ranks)]`；`weights` 按 `weight_sets` 序，第 l 项为 `[S,D,G,C,a,s,M,R,L,U]`，前六值取 `metrics[l]`，后四值取 `intervals[l]` 并复制为二维 list；`warning` 按 `o` 中 `[runs,levels,triggers,first,cumulative]` 的顺序，所有内层容器递归转 list，`None` 保留；数值不舍入
  - `robust_policy_sensitivity(H, W, thresholds, quantiles, policies, options, budget, weight_sets, zs)`：稳健方案与预警策略对区间倍数 `z` 的敏感性扫描（仅自 `air_quality.health` 导出，不入包根）。除 `zs` 外，参数约束与每种错误条件的异常类型沿用 `robust_policy_report`，异常原样传播。`zs` 为非空 list/tuple，元素为非 bool 有限 int/float、≥0 且严格递增；容器或元素类型错抛 `TypeError`，空、非有限（含 int 转 float 溢出）、负值或非递增抛 `ValueError`。对每个 `z` 按序以其余同参仅调用一次 `robust_policy_report`，结果记 `R[r]`。将 `R` 中相同 `(choice,policy)` 分组，`S` 按首次出现序存 `[choice副本, policy, 次数]`；`D` 第 r 行为 `R[r+1]` 与 `R[r]` 的 `robustness[2]` 逐项之差，`G` 第 r 行为两者 `warning[1]` 逐项之差；仅一个 `z` 时 `D`、`G` 为空。返回键依次为 `z`、`reports`、`selection_counts`、`rank_changes`、`level_changes` 的 dict，值依次为 `zs` 转 float 的 list、`R`、`S`、`D`、`G`，均按 `zs` 及原 `weight_sets`/`quantiles` 序；全部容器 JSON 兼容，`None` 保留，数值不舍入
  - `robust_policy_grid(H, W, thresholds, quantiles, policies, options, budgets, weight_sets, zs)`：稳健方案与预警策略在预算×区间倍数网格上的扫描（仅自 `air_quality.health` 导出，不入包根）。除 `budgets`、`zs` 外，参数约束与每种错误条件的异常类型沿用 `robust_policy_report`，异常原样传播；`budgets`、`zs` 均沿用 `robust_policy_sensitivity` 的 `zs` 契约（非空 list/tuple，非 bool 有限 int/float、≥0 且严格递增；容器或元素类型错抛 `TypeError`，空、非有限含 int 转 float 溢出、负值或非递增抛 `ValueError`）。以 `budgets` 为外层、`zs` 为内层，每格 `(budget,z)` 以其余同参仅调用一次 `robust_policy_report`，结果组成 B×Z 矩阵 `R`。`stability[b]` 按 `z` 序存同 `(choice,policy)` 选择的极大连续段，每段为 `[首z, 末z, choice副本, policy]`。`rank_changes`、`level_changes` 均为键依次 `z`、`budget` 的 dict：`z` 值为 B×(Z−1) 矩阵，取 `R[b][r+1]` 与 `R[b][r]` 的 `robustness[2]`（或 `warning[1]`）逐项后减前；`budget` 值为 (B−1)×Z 矩阵，取 `R[b+1][r]` 与 `R[b][r]` 的同项差；单点轴对应维度为空。返回键依次为 `budgets`、`z`、`reports`、`stability`、`rank_changes`、`level_changes` 的 dict，前两项为 `budgets`、`zs` 转 float 的 list，`reports` 即 `R`；均按 `budgets`/`zs` 及原 `weight_sets`/`quantiles` 序，全部容器 JSON 兼容，`None` 保留，数值不舍入
  - `robust_policy_grid_turns(H, W, thresholds, quantiles, policies, options, budgets, weight_sets, zs)`：稳健网格状态沿预算与区间倍数两轴的转折点扫描（仅自 `air_quality.health` 导出，不入包根）。参数约束与每种错误条件的异常类型沿用 `robust_policy_grid`，异常原样传播；仅调用 `robust_policy_grid` 一次得 `G`。状态 `S[b][r]=[choice副本, policy, robustness[2]副本, warning[1]副本]`，取自 `G["reports"][b][r]`，依次表示方案、策略、各权重名次、各分位预警等级。z 轴相邻状态按 b 升序、再按 `r=1..Z−1` 比较；budget 轴相邻状态按 `b=1..B−1`、再按 r 升序比较。仅状态不等时记事件 `[[前b,前r],[后b,后r],前状态,后状态,fields]`，`fields` 按 `choice,policy,ranks,levels` 顺序列出变化项。返回键依次为 `budgets`、`z`、`states`、`z_changes`、`budget_changes` 的 dict：前两项为 `G` 同名浮点列表副本，`states` 为 B×Z 状态列表，后两项为上述扫描序事件列表；无变化或对应轴单点时为空，多次变化全部保留。全部容器 JSON 兼容，数值不舍入
  - `robust_policy_grid_regions(H, W, thresholds, quantiles, policies, options, budgets, weight_sets, zs)`：稳健网格上等状态单元的正交连通分区（仅自 `air_quality.health` 导出，不入包根）。参数约束与每种错误条件的异常类型沿用 `robust_policy_grid_turns`，异常原样传播；仅调用 `robust_policy_grid_turns` 一次得 `G`。坐标 `[b,r]` 仅与上下左右四个单元相邻；两单元状态按 `G["states"]` 对应列表值是否相等判定。按 b 外层、r 内层扫描未归属单元，从该单元出发泛洪填充，将同状态且正交可达的单元归为一区；区域 id 自 0 按扫描序递增，每区成员按 `(b,r)` 升序。每个区域为键依次 `id`、`cells`、`budget_bounds`、`z_bounds`、`state` 的 dict：`cells` 为成员 `[b,r]` 列表；`budget_bounds` 为成员 b 极小、极大下标对应预算组成的二元 float 列表，`z_bounds` 为成员 r 极小、极大下标对应 z 值的二元 float 列表；`state` 为该状态的递归 list 副本。任意两个不同区域存在正交相邻成员即形成边 `[小id, 大id]`，去重后按两 id 升序排列。返回键依次为 `budgets`、`z`、`states`、`regions`、`adjacency` 的 dict：前三项为 `G` 同名值的递归 list 副本，`regions` 按 id 序，`adjacency` 为边列表。全部容器 JSON 兼容，`None` 保留，数值不舍入
  - `robust_policy_region_flow(H, W, thresholds, quantiles, policies, options, budgets, weight_sets, zs)`：稳健网格分区在预算轴与区间倍数轴上逐片的流动（仅自 `air_quality.health` 导出，不入包根）。参数约束与每种错误条件的异常类型沿用 `robust_policy_grid_regions`，异常原样传播；仅调用 `robust_policy_grid_regions` 一次得 `G`，以 `G` 的区域给每个单元 `[b,r]` 赋区域 id，组成 B×Z 的 id 网格。固定 b 沿 r 扫、固定 r 沿 b 扫两种切片分别压缩为同 id 的极大连续段，每段记 `[首坐标, 末坐标, id, state副本]`（首、末为该片扫描方向的下标，state 为该区域状态的递归 list 副本），段在片内按扫描序自 0 递增编号。相邻两片的段共享同一 id 且下标区间相交（共享单元跨片相接）即连边；在两张有序段表间的连边图为二部图，依段序求其连通分量（含孤立段），每个分量按前段数→后段数记一个事件 `[kind, from, to, overlap]`：`from`/`to` 为该片段下标的升序列表，`overlap` 为各连边交集坐标（budget 片为 r 下标、z 片为 b 下标）去重后的升序并集，`kind` 依 `0→多、多→0、1→1、1→多、多→1、多→多` 取 `enter、exit、continue、split、merge、merge_split`。片内相邻且异 id 的单元对组成去重升序边集；每对相邻片记 `[前片, 后片, 新增边, 移除边]`（两边集之差，边为 `[小id,大id]`）。返回键依次为 `budgets`、`z`、`axes` 的 dict：前两项为 `G` 同名值副本，`axes` 为键依次 `budget`、`z` 的 dict，各值为键依次 `slices`、`events`、`adjacency_changes` 的 dict——`slices` 按片列各片段表，`events` 按相邻片对列各分量事件，`adjacency_changes` 按相邻片对列边集差；轴上仅一片时 `events`、`adjacency_changes` 为空。全部容器 JSON 兼容，`None` 保留，数值不舍入
  - `robust_policy_lineage(H, W, thresholds, quantiles, policies, options, budgets, weight_sets, zs)`：沿预算轴与区间倍数轴两片流追踪区域谱系（仅自 `air_quality.health` 导出，不入包根）。参数约束与每种错误条件的异常类型沿用 `robust_policy_region_flow`，异常原样传播；仅调用 `robust_policy_region_flow` 一次得 `F`。两轴均先按片序（budget 轴按预算序、z 轴按 z 序）、片内再按扫描段序将 `slices` 展平，每个段依展平序成为一个全局自 0 递增 id 的节点，节点记 `[id, 片, 段, 首, 末, region, state]`：片、段为该段所属片下标与片内段下标，首、末为该段扫描下标区间两端，region 为其区域 id，state 为该段 state 的递归 list 副本。将 `F` 各事件 from/to 中的段号替换为对应节点 id，`transitions` 按相邻片对存为 `[kind, from, to, overlap]`（顺序与事件序一致，from/to 为节点 id 升序列表，overlap 沿用原值）；from×to 的笛卡尔对中两节点 region 相同且扫描下标区间相交者方为有向边。忽略边方向取无向连通分量，并按分量内最小节点 id 自小到大编号；每个谱系记 `[id, nodes, entries, exits, paths, changes]`：nodes 为分量内节点 id 升序列表；entries、exits 分别为分量内入度为 0、出度为 0 的节点升序列表；paths 为覆盖分量全部有向边、且每个内点入度与出度均为 1 的极大有向路径列表，孤点单列为单节点路径，全部路径按列表字典序排列；changes 为 `F` 的非空邻接变化记录（`[前片, 后片, 新增边, 移除边]`）中至少有一条边的某个端点区域 id 属于该分量所含 region 的记录，按原片对序列出。返回键依次为 `budgets`、`z`、`axes` 的 dict：前两项沿用 `F` 同名值，`axes` 为键依次 `budget`、`z` 的 dict，各轴值为键依次 `nodes`、`transitions`、`lineages` 的 dict；轴上仅一片时 `transitions` 为空、各节点自成孤立谱系。全部容器 JSON 兼容，`None` 保留，数值不舍入
  - `robust_policy_joint(H, W, thresholds, quantiles, policies, options, budgets, weight_sets, zs)`：按区域合并两轴谱系（仅自 `air_quality.health` 导出，不入包根）。参数约束与每种错误条件的异常类型沿用 `robust_policy_lineage`，异常原样传播；仅调用 `robust_policy_lineage` 一次得 `L`。节点的区域取其 region 项、状态取其 state 项，状态第 2 项为各权重名次 ranks、第 3 项为各分位等级 levels。`regions` 按 region 升序列出两轴出现过的每个区域，每项 `[region, state, B, Z]`：state 取 budget 轴上该区域首节点（该轴含该区域、id 最小的节点，即最低预算片）state 的递归 list 副本；B、Z 分别为 budget、z 两轴含该 region 的谱系 id 去重后升序列表。`branches` 按 budget、z 轴序、片对序、事件序，收齐 kind 为 split、merge、merge_split 的事件，每项 `[axis, pair, kind, from, to, overlap]`：axis 为 `budget`/`z`，pair 为 `[前片, 后片]`，from/to 为事件节点 id 列表，overlap 沿用原值。`adjacency_changes` 按 budget、z 轴序、谱系 id 升序、各谱系 changes 原序，每条记录先展开 added 边再展开 removed 边；区域 id 边 `[r0,r1]` 以小 region 为小端，每条边产出一项 `[axis, 前片, 后片, action, 小region, 大region, rank差, level差]` 并跨谱系去重：action 为 `add`（新增边）或 `remove`（移除边），rank 差、level 差为大 region 状态的 ranks、levels 逐项减小 region 状态对应项的列表；同一轴、片对、action、区域对被多个谱系展开时只保留一次。返回键依次为 `budgets`、`z`、`regions`、`branches`、`adjacency_changes` 的 dict：前两项为 `L` 同名值的递归 list 副本。全部容器 JSON 兼容，`None` 保留，数值不舍入
  - `robust_policy_change_summary(H, W, thresholds, quantiles, policies, options, budgets, weight_sets, zs)`：按区域汇总分支事件数并比对两轴邻接变化是否一致（仅自 `air_quality.health` 导出，不入包根）。参数约束与每种错误条件的异常类型沿用 `robust_policy_joint`，异常原样传播；仅调用 `robust_policy_joint` 一次得 `J`、`robust_policy_lineage` 一次得 `L`。以 `L` 各轴 nodes 将该轴节点 id 映射为 region；`J` 的 branches 中每条 branch 所涉 region 为其 from/to 节点经同轴映射后取值的并集，故一条 branch 在每个 region、每个轴/类槽位至多计一次。返回键依次为 `budgets`、`z`、`regions`、`consistent`、`conflicts` 的 dict：前两项为 `J` 同名值的递归 list 副本。`regions` 沿用 `J` 的 region 集合按 region 升序，每项 `[region, B, RI, LI]`：`B` 为 6 个事件数，先按 budget、z 轴序，轴内按 split、merge、merge_split 序，事件按 region 去重计数（region 无事件时为 6 个 0）；`RI`、`LI` 分别为 `J` 的 `adjacency_changes` 中以该 region 为端点的各条目的 rank 差、level 差各元素绝对值的 `math.fsum`（无端点条目时为 `fsum([])=0.0`）。对在两轴均有条目的无序 region 对 `(小region,大region)`，各轴按 `J` 原序收集 `[action, rank差副本, level差副本]` 三元组列表（rank 差、level 差为逐元素 list 副本）；两列表逐项相等归 `consistent`，否则归 `conflicts`，每项 `[小region, 大region, budget列表, z列表]`，均按 region 对升序排列；仅出现在一轴的 region 对不入两表。全部容器 JSON 兼容，数值不舍入
  - `robust_policy_priority(H, W, thresholds, quantiles, policies, options, budgets, weight_sets, zs)`：按冲突优先级排列 region 与 region 对（仅自 `air_quality.health` 导出，不入包根）。参数及逐项异常沿用 `robust_policy_change_summary` 并原样传播；仅调用 `robust_policy_change_summary` 一次得 `S`，`F=math.fsum`，`copy` 为递归 list 复制。对 `S["conflicts"]` 每项 `[a,b,BA,ZA]`，令 `C=len(BA)+len(ZA)`、`RI=F(abs(x) for e in BA+ZA for x in e[1])`、`LI=F(abs(x) for e in BA+ZA for x in e[2])`；`pairs` 项为 `[a,b,C,RI,LI,copy(BA),copy(ZA)]`，按 `(-LI,-RI,-C,a,b)` 升序。对 `S["regions"]` 每项 `[r,B,RI,LI]`，`details` 收含 `r` 的冲突为 `[另一端,copy(BA),copy(ZA)]` 并按另一端升序；`regions` 项为 `[r,copy(B),F(B),RI,LI,len(details),details]`，按 `(-len(details),-LI,-RI,-F(B),r)` 升序。返回键依次为 `budgets`、`z`、`regions`、`pairs` 的 dict，前两值为 `S` 同名值的递归 list 副本；全部容器 JSON 兼容，`None` 保留，数值不舍入
  - `robust_policy_actions(H, W, thresholds, quantiles, policies, options, budgets, weight_sets, zs)`：按冲突优先级生成 region 与 region 对的行动队列（仅自 `air_quality.health` 导出，不入包根）。参数及逐项异常沿用 `robust_policy_priority` 并原样传播；仅调用 `robust_policy_priority` 一次得 `P`。令 `BR=[P["budgets"][0],P["budgets"][-1]]`、`ZR=[P["z"][0],P["z"][-1]]`。`P["regions"]` 每项 `[r,B,T,RI,LI,n,D]` 按其在 `P["regions"]` 中的原序以 0 基名次 i 转为 `[i,"region",r,BR,ZR,B,T,RI,LI,n,D]`；`P["pairs"]` 每项 `[a,b,C,RI,LI,BA,ZA]` 按其在 `P["pairs"]` 中的原序以 0 基名次 i 转为 `[i,"pair",[a,b],BR,ZR,C,RI,LI,[["budget",BA],["z",ZA]]]`。返回键依次为 `budgets`、`z`、`queue` 的 dict：前两值为 `P` 同名值的递归 list 副本，`queue` 先列 region 行动再列 pair 行动，各组保持 `P` 的优先级顺序。所有列表递归复制，全部容器 JSON 兼容，`None` 保留，数值不舍入
  - `robust_policy_action_batches(H, W, thresholds, quantiles, policies, options, budgets, weight_sets, zs, capacity=10)`：将冲突优先级行动队列按固定批容切批（仅自 `air_quality.health` 导出，不入包根）。除 `capacity` 外参数及逐项异常沿用 `robust_policy_actions` 并原样传播，仅调用 `robust_policy_actions` 一次得 `A`；`capacity` 为非 bool 且 `>=1` 的 int，类型错抛 `TypeError`，小于 1 抛 `ValueError`。按 `A["queue"]` 原序每 `capacity` 项切一批（末批可较短）；`region` 行动取其 0 基第 7、8 项、`pair` 行动取其 0 基第 6、7 项作为名次、等级影响，批内以 `math.fsum` 汇总为 `R`、`L`，`CR`、`CL` 为截至本批（含）各批 `R`、`L` 的 `math.fsum`。返回键依次为 `budgets`、`z`、`capacity`、`batches` 的 dict：前两值复制 `A` 同名值，`batches` 每项为键依次 `id`、`range`、`items`、`rank`、`level`、`cumulative` 的 dict，值依次为 0 基批号、半开区间 `[起始下标,结束下标]`、行动的递归 list 副本、`R`、`L`、`[CR,CL]`；空队列返回空 `batches`。全部容器 JSON 兼容，`None` 保留，数值不舍入
  - `robust_policy_action_progress(H, W, thresholds, quantiles, policies, options, budgets, weight_sets, zs, capacity=10, rank_threshold=0.0, level_threshold=0.0)`：分批行动队列的累计名次/等级进度（仅自 `air_quality.health` 导出，不入包根）。除两阈值外参数及逐项异常沿用 `robust_policy_action_batches` 并原样传播，仅调用 `robust_policy_action_batches` 一次得 `A`，`Q` 为行动总数；`rank_threshold`、`level_threshold` 各为非 bool、非负的 int 或有限 float（任意大的 int 均原样接受、不转 float），错型抛 `TypeError`，非有限 float 或负值抛 `ValueError`。对 `A["batches"]` 逐批取 `e=range[1]`、`[CR,CL]=cumulative`，`R`、`P` 分别为该批 region、pair 行动按批内顺序取第 0 项（0 基全局名次）组成的列表；进度项为 `[id,e,CR,CL,CR≥rank_threshold,CL≥level_threshold,Q−e,R,P]`。`fr`、`fl` 分别为名次、等级布尔项首次为真的批 id，从无真值取 `None`。返回键依次为 `budgets`、`z`、`capacity`、`progress`、`summary` 的 dict：前三值递归复制 `A` 同名值，`summary=[Q,批数,末批CR,末批CL,fr,fl]`，空批时末批累计取 `0.0`。全部容器 JSON 兼容，`None` 保留，数值不舍入
  - `robust_policy_action_waves(H, W, thresholds, quantiles, policies, options, budgets, weight_sets, zs, capacity=10, rank_threshold=0.0, level_threshold=0.0, cursor=0)`：在批游标处将进度项分为 done/pending 波次（仅自 `air_quality.health` 导出，不入包根）。除 `cursor` 外参数及逐项异常沿用 `robust_policy_action_progress` 并原样传播，仅调用 `robust_policy_action_progress` 一次得 `P`，`Q`、`B` 取 `P["summary"]` 前两项（行动总数、批数）；`cursor` 为非 bool int 且 `0≤cursor≤B`，错型抛 `TypeError`、越界抛 `ValueError`。对 `P["progress"]` 每项 `x`（按序）输出 `[status]+copy(x)+[x[0]+1]`，`x[0]<cursor` 时 `status="done"`、否则 `"pending"`，`copy` 为递归 list 复制。`hits` 按名次标志（`x[4]`）、等级标志（`x[5]`）序，各取标志首次为真的 `x` 的第 0、1、7、8 项递归副本，无真值取 `None`。`done` 在 `cursor=0` 时为 0，否则取前批 `P["progress"][cursor−1][1]`。返回键依次为 `budgets`、`z`、`capacity`、`cursor`、`waves`、`hits`、`summary` 的 dict：前三值递归复制 `P` 同名值，`summary=[Q,B,done,Q−done]`。所有列表递归复制，全部容器 JSON 兼容，数值不舍入
  - `robust_policy_action_confirm(H, W, thresholds, quantiles, policies, options, budgets, weight_sets, zs, capacity=10, rank_threshold=0.0, level_threshold=0.0, cursor=0, *, target_cursor)`：在批游标与目标游标之间确认波次（仅自 `air_quality.health` 导出，不入包根）。签名为 `robust_policy_action_waves` 参数末增必填仅关键字参数 `target_cursor`；除 `target_cursor` 外参数及逐项异常沿用 `robust_policy_action_waves` 并原样传播。`target_cursor` 为非 bool int，错型抛 `TypeError`。以 `target_cursor` 替代 `cursor` 仅调用 `robust_policy_action_waves` 一次得 `W`，令 `V=W["waves"]`，`Q`、`B` 取 `W["summary"]` 前两项；须满足 `0≤cursor≤target_cursor≤B`（其中 `0≤target_cursor≤B` 由 waves 调用强制），否则抛 `ValueError`。`old` 在 `cursor=0` 时为 0，否则取 `V[cursor−1][2]`；`new` 取 `W["summary"][2]`。返回键依次为 `budgets`、`z`、`capacity`、`from_cursor`、`to_cursor`、`confirmed`、`pending`、`hits`、`summary` 的 dict：前三值递归复制 `W` 同名值，两游标为原 `cursor`、`target_cursor`；`confirmed`、`pending` 分别递归复制 `V[cursor:target_cursor]`、`V[target_cursor:]`；`hits` 递归复制 `W["hits"]`；`summary=[Q,B,old,new,new−old,Q−new,target_cursor]`。所有列表递归复制，全部容器 JSON 兼容，`None` 保留，数值不舍入
  - `robust_policy_action_checkpoint(H, W, thresholds, quantiles, policies, options, budgets, weight_sets, zs, capacity=10, rank_threshold=0.0, level_threshold=0.0, cursor=0, *, target_cursor, expected_done)`：确认波次并校验此前已完成行动数（仅自 `air_quality.health` 导出，不入包根）。签名为 `robust_policy_action_confirm` 在 `target_cursor` 后增加必填仅关键字参数 `expected_done`；其余参数及逐项异常沿用 `robust_policy_action_confirm` 并原样传播。`expected_done` 为非 bool 且 ≥0 的 int，错型抛 `TypeError`，负值抛 `ValueError`。仅调用 `robust_policy_action_confirm` 一次得 `C`，令 `old`、`new`、`delta`、`remaining` 依次为 `C["summary"]` 的第 2 至 5 项（0 基，即 `old`、`new`、`new−old`、`Q−new`）；若 `expected_done != old` 抛 `RuntimeError`。返回键依次为 `budgets`、`z`、`capacity`、`checkpoint`、`confirmed`、`pending`、`hits` 的 dict：其中六项递归复制 `C` 的同名值，`checkpoint` 为键依次 `from_cursor`、`to_cursor`、`next_cursor`、`old_done`、`done`、`delta`、`remaining` 的 dict，值依次为 `C["from_cursor"]`、`C["to_cursor"]`、`C["to_cursor"]`、`old`、`new`、`delta`、`remaining`。`target_cursor==cursor` 合法，此时 `confirmed` 为空、`delta` 为 0。全部容器 JSON 兼容，`None` 保留，数值不舍入
  - `robust_policy_action_restore(checkpoints, cursor=0, expected_done=0)`：回放行动队列检查点以恢复已确认状态（仅自 `air_quality.health` 导出，不入包根）。`checkpoints` 为非空 list/tuple，各项为 `robust_policy_action_checkpoint` 的返回 dict（键恰为 `budgets`、`z`、`capacity`、`checkpoint`、`confirmed`、`pending`、`hits`；`budgets`、`z` 为非空有限非负数列表，`capacity` 为非 bool int ≥1，`confirmed`、`pending`、`hits` 为 list，`checkpoint` 为键恰含 `from_cursor`、`to_cursor`、`next_cursor`、`old_done`、`done`、`delta`、`remaining` 的 dict，七值均为非 bool 且 ≥0 的 int），各项的 `budgets`、`z`、`capacity` 必须完全一致。`cursor`、`expected_done` 为非 bool 且 ≥0 的 int。容器、标量类型错或元素非 dict 抛 `TypeError`；空序列、键缺失/多余或结构错误、负值、各项 `budgets`/`z`/`capacity` 不一致、`next_cursor≠to_cursor`、`delta≠done−old_done`、`remaining<0` 或 `to_cursor<from_cursor`（游标回退）抛 `ValueError`。首项的 `from_cursor`、`old_done` 必须分别等于 `cursor`、`expected_done`，其后每项的二者必须分别等于前项的 `to_cursor`、`done`，否则抛 `RuntimeError`；零增量、同游标的检查点允许重复回放，空队列允许 0→0 记录。返回键依次为 `state`、`history`、`pending`、`hits` 的 dict：`state=[末项next_cursor, 末项done, 末项remaining]`，`history` 为各项 `checkpoint` 按序的递归 list/dict 副本，`pending`、`hits` 递归复制末项同名值。全部容器 JSON 兼容，`None` 保留，数值不舍入

14196	def _alert_region_normalize_history(history: object, universe: set[int]) -> list:
14197	    """Structurally validate and normalize a checkpoint history.
14198	
14199	    Covers container/item/element types (``TypeError``) and shapes,
14200	    duplicates, crossing groups, universe coverage and per-item
14201	    transition consistency (``ValueError``). Cross-item chaining and
14202	    the match against the current state are checked separately by
14203	    :func:`_alert_region_check_history_chain`.
14204	    """
14205	    if not isinstance(history, (list, tuple)):
14206	        raise TypeError(
14207	            f"history must be a list or tuple, got {type(history).__name__}"
14208	        )
14209	    normalized_history: list = []
14210	    for history_index, item in enumerate(history):
14211	        where = f"history[{history_index}]"
14212	        if not isinstance(item, (list, tuple)):
14213	            raise TypeError(
14214	                f"{where} must be a list or tuple, got {type(item).__name__}"
14215	            )
14216	        if len(item) != 4:
14217	            raise ValueError(
14218	                f"{where} must have exactly 4 items "
14219	                "[pre_state, post_state, finish, retry], "
14220	                f"got {len(item)}"
14221	            )
14222	        pre_state = _alert_region_normalize_state(
14223	            item[0], f"{where}[0]", universe
14224	        )
14225	        post_state = _alert_region_normalize_state(
14226	            item[1], f"{where}[1]", universe
14227	        )
14228	        step_finish = _alert_region_normalize_id_list(
14229	            item[2], f"{where}[2] (finish)"
14230	        )
14231	        step_retry = _alert_region_normalize_id_list(
14232	            item[3], f"{where}[3] (retry)"
14233	        )
14234	
14235	        pre_sets = [set(group) for group in pre_state]
14236	        bad_step_finish = sorted(
14237	            region_id for region_id in step_finish
14238	            if region_id not in pre_sets[2]
14239	        )
14240	        if bad_step_finish:
14241	            raise ValueError(
14242	                f"{where} finish id(s) must come from its pre-state U "
14243	                f"group: {bad_step_finish}"
14244	            )
14245	        bad_step_retry = sorted(
14246	            region_id for region_id in step_retry
14247	            if region_id not in pre_sets[1]
14248	        )
14249	        if bad_step_retry:
14250	            raise ValueError(
14251	                f"{where} retry id(s) must come from its pre-state F "
14252	                f"group: {bad_step_retry}"
14253	            )
14254	        expected_post = [
14255	            sorted(pre_sets[0] | set(step_finish)),
14256	            sorted(pre_sets[1] - set(step_retry)),
14257	            sorted((pre_sets[2] - set(step_finish)) | set(step_retry)),
14258	        ]

14261	                f"{where} post-state does not match its finish/retry "
14262	                "transition"
14263	            )

14266	        )

14308	) -> list:

14319	def alert_region_step(
14320	    progress: dict,
14321	    finish: list | tuple,
14322	    retry: list | tuple,
14323	    history: list | tuple = (),
14324	) -> dict:
14325	    """Commit one finish/retry step on an alert-region progress state.
14326	
14327	    ``progress`` must be a result of :func:`alert_region_progress`; its
14328	    keys must be exactly ``thresholds``, ``minimums``, ``state``,
14329	    ``batches``, ``layers`` and ``configs``. A wrong type raises
14330	    ``TypeError``; a missing or extra key raises ``ValueError``.
14331	
14332	    ``thresholds`` and ``minimums`` must each be a non-empty list (or
14333	    tuple) of finite non-bool int/float numbers. ``state`` must be
14334	    ``[D, F, U]``: three lists (or tuples) of non-bool int region ids,
14335	    pairwise disjoint and together covering one region universe; the
14336	    groups are normalized to ascending id order (a genuine
14337	    :func:`alert_region_progress` result is accepted whatever its group
14338	    order).
14339	
14340	    ``batches`` must be a non-empty list (or tuple) of
14341	    ``[id, D_b, F_b, U_b, totals]`` items and ``layers`` one of
14342	    ``[layer, D_l, F_l, U_l]`` items. Every group is a list (or tuple)
14343	    of unique non-bool ints. Across all entries of one table the groups
14344	    must be pairwise disjoint and their union must be exactly the
14345	    ``state`` universe (no duplicate, missing or extra id), each id
14346	    must sit in the same D/F/U group as in ``state``, the headers must
14347	    be the contiguous range ``0..n-1`` in listed order, and each batch
14348	    ``totals`` must be three finite numbers.
14349	
14350	    ``configs`` must be a list (or tuple) of
14351	    ``[p, D_p, F_p, U_p]`` items with unique non-bool int ``p`` values;
14352	    each item's three groups are lists (or tuples) of unique non-bool
14353	    ints, pairwise disjoint, and must equal the intersections of that
14354	    configuration's region set with the three ``state`` groups
14355	    (``R_p ∩ D``, ``R_p ∩ F``, ``R_p ∩ U``). A wrong container, item,
14356	    group, scalar or id type raises ``TypeError``; a wrong shape, an
14357	    empty or non-finite number list, a duplicate, crossing groups, a
14358	    non-contiguous header, a missing/extra id or a group that does not
14359	    match the state partition/intersection raises ``ValueError``.
14360	
14361	    ``finish`` and ``retry`` must each be a list or tuple of unique
14362	    non-bool int region ids; empty sequences are allowed. A wrong
14363	    container or element type raises ``TypeError`` and a duplicate id
14364	    raises ``ValueError``. Every ``finish`` id must be taken from ``U``
14365	    and every ``retry`` id from ``F`` or a ``RuntimeError`` is raised.
14366	
14367	    ``history`` must be a list or tuple of checkpoints; each item is
14368	    ``[[D, F, U], [D', F', U'], finish_copy, retry_copy]``: two
14369	    three-group states followed by the finish/retry id lists of that
14370	    step. Group ids may be in any order and are normalized to
14371	    ascending order before comparison. Item, container or element
14372	    type errors raise ``TypeError``; wrong lengths, duplicate ids,
14373	    crossing groups, ids outside the region universe of ``progress``
14374	    or a post-state that does not equal
14375	    ``[D | finish, F - retry, (U - finish) | retry]`` raise
14376	    ``ValueError``. Adjacent items must connect (an item's pre-state
14377	    must equal the previous item's post-state) and the last item's
14378	    post-state must equal the current state of ``progress``;
14379	    otherwise a ``RuntimeError`` is raised. An empty history is
14380	    allowed.
14381	
14382	    Returns a dict whose keys in order are ``thresholds``,
14383	    ``minimums``, ``checkpoint``, ``history`` and ``changes``: the
14384	    first two values recursively copy the same-named entries of
14385	    ``progress``, ``checkpoint`` is
14386	    ``[[D, F, U], [D', F', U'], finish_copy, retry_copy]`` with every
14387	    id list pairwise disjoint as applicable and sorted ascending by
14388	    id (the finish/retry copies are sorted copies), ``history``
14389	    recursively copies every given checkpoint in order and appends the
14390	    new checkpoint, and ``changes`` lists, in the order of
14391	    ``progress["configs"]``, one ``[p, finished_ids, retried_ids]``
14392	    per configuration affected by this step, with both id lists sorted
14393	    ascending. Every container is recursively copied and JSON-
14394	    compatible (numbers never rounded); the inputs are never modified.
14395	    """
14396	    validated = _alert_region_validate_progress(progress)
14397	    current = validated["current"]
14398	    current_sets = [set(group) for group in current]
14399	    configs = validated["configs"]
14400	    universe = current_sets[0] | current_sets[1] | current_sets[2]
14401	
14402	    finish_ids = _alert_region_normalize_id_list(finish, "finish")
14403	    retry_ids = _alert_region_normalize_id_list(retry, "retry")
14404	
14405	    normalized_history = _alert_region_normalize_history(history, universe)
14406	
14407	    bad_finish = sorted(
14408	        region_id for region_id in finish_ids
14409	        if region_id not in current_sets[2]
14410	    )
14411	    if bad_finish:
14412	        raise RuntimeError(
14413	            "finish ids must be taken from U (unlisted regions), bad "
14414	            f"id(s): {bad_finish}"
14415	        )
14416	    bad_retry = sorted(
14417	        region_id for region_id in retry_ids
14418	        if region_id not in current_sets[1]
14419	    )
14420	    if bad_retry:
14421	        raise RuntimeError(
14422	            "retry ids must be taken from F (failed regions), bad "
14423	            f"id(s): {bad_retry}"
14424	        )
14425	
14426	    _alert_region_check_history_chain(normalized_history, current)
14427	
14428	    finish_set = set(finish_ids)
14429	    retry_set = set(retry_ids)
14430	    new_state = [
14431	        sorted(current_sets[0] | finish_set),
14432	        sorted(current_sets[1] - retry_set),
14433	        sorted((current_sets[2] - finish_set) | retry_set),
14434	    ]
14435	    checkpoint = _alert_region_checkpoint(
14436	        current, new_state, finish_ids, retry_ids
14437	    )
14438	
14439	    history_out = [
14440	        _alert_region_checkpoint(
14441	            pre_state, post_state, step_finish, step_retry
14442	        )
14443	        for pre_state, post_state, step_finish, step_retry
14444	        in normalized_history
14445	    ]
14446	    history_out.append(
14447	        _alert_region_checkpoint(current, new_state, finish_ids, retry_ids)
14448	    )
14449	
14450	    changes = _alert_region_config_changes(configs, finish_set, retry_set)
14451	
14452	    return {
14453	        "thresholds": _alert_region_copy(validated["thresholds"]),
14454	        "minimums": _alert_region_copy(validated["minimums"]),
14455	        "checkpoint": checkpoint,
14456	        "history": history_out,
14457	        "changes": changes,
14458	    }

def _alert_region_normalize_history(history: object, universe: set[int]) -> list:
    """Structurally validate and normalize a checkpoint history.

    Covers container/item/element types (``TypeError``) and shapes,
    duplicates, crossing groups, universe coverage and per-item
    transition consistency (``ValueError``). Cross-item chaining and
    the match against the current state are checked separately by
    :func:`_alert_region_check_history_chain`.
    """
    if not isinstance(history, (list, tuple)):
        raise TypeError(
            f"history must be a list or tuple, got {type(history).__name__}"
        )
    normalized_history: list = []
    for history_index, item in enumerate(history):
        where = f"history[{history_index}]"
        if not isinstance(item, (list, tuple)):
            raise TypeError(
                f"{where} must be a list or tuple, got {type(item).__name__}"
            )
        if len(item) != 4:
            raise ValueError(
                f"{where} must have exactly 4 items "
                "[pre_state, post_state, finish, retry], "
                f"got {len(item)}"
            )
        pre_state = _alert_region_normalize_state(
            item[0], f"{where}[0]", universe
        )
        post_state = _alert_region_normalize_state(
            item[1], f"{where}[1]", universe
        )
        step_finish = _alert_region_normalize_id_list(
            item[2], f"{where}[2] (finish)"
        )
        step_retry = _alert_region_normalize_id_list(
            item[3], f"{where}[3] (retry)"
        )

        pre_sets = [set(group) for group in pre_state]
        bad_step_finish = sorted(
            region_id for region_id in step_finish
            if region_id not in pre_sets[2]
        )
        if bad_step_finish:
            raise ValueError(
                f"{where} finish id(s) must come from its pre-state U "
                f"group: {bad_step_finish}"
            )
        bad_step_retry = sorted(
            region_id for region_id in step_retry
            if region_id not in pre_sets[1]
        )
        if bad_step_retry:
            raise ValueError(
                f"{where} retry id(s) must come from its pre-state F "
                f"group: {bad_step_retry}"
            )
        expected_post = [
            sorted(pre_sets[0] | set(step_finish)),
            sorted(pre_sets[1] - set(step_retry)),
            sorted((pre_sets[2] - set(step_finish)) | set(step_retry)),
        ]
        if expected_post != post_state:
            raise ValueError(
                f"{where} post-state does not match its finish/retry "
                "transition"
            )
        normalized_history.append(
            [pre_state, post_state, step_finish, step_retry]
        )
    return normalized_history


def _alert_region_check_history_chain(
    normalized_history: list, current: list
) -> None:
    """Check checkpoint chaining and the match against current state.

    Raises ``RuntimeError``; run only after structural validation and
    step eligibility checks.
    """
    for history_index in range(1, len(normalized_history)):
        if normalized_history[history_index][0] != \
                normalized_history[history_index - 1][1]:
            raise RuntimeError(
                f"history[{history_index}] pre-state does not follow "
                f"history[{history_index - 1}] post-state"
            )
    if normalized_history and normalized_history[-1][1] != current:
        raise RuntimeError(
            "the last history checkpoint post-state does not match the "
            "current progress state"
        )


def _alert_region_checkpoint(
    pre_state: list,
    post_state: list,
    finish_ids: list,
    retry_ids: list,
) -> list:
    return [
        [list(group) for group in pre_state],
        [list(group) for group in post_state],
        sorted(finish_ids),
        sorted(retry_ids),
    ]


def _alert_region_config_changes(
    configs: list, finish_set: set, retry_set: set
) -> list:
    changes: list = []
    for p_value, done_group, failed_group, unlisted_group in configs:
        regions = set(done_group) | set(failed_group) | set(unlisted_group)
        finished_here = sorted(finish_set & regions)
        retried_here = sorted(retry_set & regions)
        if finished_here or retried_here:
            changes.append([p_value, finished_here, retried_here])
    return changes


def alert_region_step(
    progress: dict,
    finish: list | tuple,
    retry: list | tuple,
    history: list | tuple = (),
) -> dict:
    """Commit one finish/retry step on an alert-region progress state.

    ``progress`` must be a result of :func:`alert_region_progress`; its
    keys must be exactly ``thresholds``, ``minimums``, ``state``,
    ``batches``, ``layers`` and ``configs``. A wrong type raises
    ``TypeError``; a missing or extra key raises ``ValueError``.

    ``thresholds`` and ``minimums`` must each be a non-empty list (or
    tuple) of finite non-bool int/float numbers. ``state`` must be
    ``[D, F, U]``: three lists (or tuples) of non-bool int region ids,
    pairwise disjoint and together covering one region universe; the
    groups are normalized to ascending id order (a genuine
    :func:`alert_region_progress` result is accepted whatever its group
    order).

    ``batches`` must be a non-empty list (or tuple) of
    ``[id, D_b, F_b, U_b, totals]`` items and ``layers`` one of
    ``[layer, D_l, F_l, U_l]`` items. Every group is a list (or tuple)
    of unique non-bool ints. Across all entries of one table the groups
    must be pairwise disjoint and their union must be exactly the
    ``state`` universe (no duplicate, missing or extra id), each id
    must sit in the same D/F/U group as in ``state``, the headers must
    be the contiguous range ``0..n-1`` in listed order, and each batch
    ``totals`` must be three finite numbers.

    ``configs`` must be a list (or tuple) of
    ``[p, D_p, F_p, U_p]`` items with unique non-bool int ``p`` values;
    each item's three groups are lists (or tuples) of unique non-bool
    ints, pairwise disjoint, and must equal the intersections of that
    configuration's region set with the three ``state`` groups
    (``R_p ∩ D``, ``R_p ∩ F``, ``R_p ∩ U``). A wrong container, item,
    group, scalar or id type raises ``TypeError``; a wrong shape, an
    empty or non-finite number list, a duplicate, crossing groups, a
    non-contiguous header, a missing/extra id or a group that does not
    match the state partition/intersection raises ``ValueError``.

    ``finish`` and ``retry`` must each be a list or tuple of unique
    non-bool int region ids; empty sequences are allowed. A wrong
    container or element type raises ``TypeError`` and a duplicate id
    raises ``ValueError``. Every ``finish`` id must be taken from ``U``
    and every ``retry`` id from ``F`` or a ``RuntimeError`` is raised.

    ``history`` must be a list or tuple of checkpoints; each item is
    ``[[D, F, U], [D', F', U'], finish_copy, retry_copy]``: two
    three-group states followed by the finish/retry id lists of that
    step. Group ids may be in any order and are normalized to
    ascending order before comparison. Item, container or element
    type errors raise ``TypeError``; wrong lengths, duplicate ids,
    crossing groups, ids outside the region universe of ``progress``
    or a post-state that does not equal
    ``[D | finish, F - retry, (U - finish) | retry]`` raise
    ``ValueError``. Adjacent items must connect (an item's pre-state
    must equal the previous item's post-state) and the last item's
    post-state must equal the current state of ``progress``;
    otherwise a ``RuntimeError`` is raised. An empty history is
    allowed.

    Returns a dict whose keys in order are ``thresholds``,
    ``minimums``, ``checkpoint``, ``history`` and ``changes``: the
    first two values recursively copy the same-named entries of
    ``progress``, ``checkpoint`` is
    ``[[D, F, U], [D', F', U'], finish_copy, retry_copy]`` with every
    id list pairwise disjoint as applicable and sorted ascending by
    id (the finish/retry copies are sorted copies), ``history``
    recursively copies every given checkpoint in order and appends the
    new checkpoint, and ``changes`` lists, in the order of
    ``progress["configs"]``, one ``[p, finished_ids, retried_ids]``
    per configuration affected by this step, with both id lists sorted
    ascending. Every container is recursively copied and JSON-
    compatible (numbers never rounded); the inputs are never modified.
    """
    validated = _alert_region_validate_progress(progress)
    current = validated["current"]
    current_sets = [set(group) for group in current]
    configs = validated["configs"]
    universe = current_sets[0] | current_sets[1] | current_sets[2]

    finish_ids = _alert_region_normalize_id_list(finish, "finish")
    retry_ids = _alert_region_normalize_id_list(retry, "retry")

    normalized_history = _alert_region_normalize_history(history, universe)

    bad_finish = sorted(
        region_id for region_id in finish_ids
        if region_id not in current_sets[2]
    )
    if bad_finish:
        raise RuntimeError(
            "finish ids must be taken from U (unlisted regions), bad "
            f"id(s): {bad_finish}"
        )
    bad_retry = sorted(
        region_id for region_id in retry_ids
        if region_id not in current_sets[1]
    )
    if bad_retry:
        raise RuntimeError(
            "retry ids must be taken from F (failed regions), bad "
            f"id(s): {bad_retry}"
        )

    _alert_region_check_history_chain(normalized_history, current)

    finish_set = set(finish_ids)
    retry_set = set(retry_ids)
    new_state = [
        sorted(current_sets[0] | finish_set),
        sorted(current_sets[1] - retry_set),
        sorted((current_sets[2] - finish_set) | retry_set),
    ]
    checkpoint = _alert_region_checkpoint(
        current, new_state, finish_ids, retry_ids
    )

    history_out = [
        _alert_region_checkpoint(
            pre_state, post_state, step_finish, step_retry
        )
        for pre_state, post_state, step_finish, step_retry
        in normalized_history
    ]
    history_out.append(
        _alert_region_checkpoint(current, new_state, finish_ids, retry_ids)
    )

    changes = _alert_region_config_changes(configs, finish_set, retry_set)

    return {
        "thresholds": _alert_region_copy(validated["thresholds"]),
        "minimums": _alert_region_copy(validated["minimums"]),
        "checkpoint": checkpoint,
        "history": history_out,
        "changes": changes,
    }

``[D, F, U]`` with every id list sorted ascending; ``checkpoints``
    lists, in step order, one
    ``[[D, F, U], [D', F', U'], finish_copy, retry_copy]`` checkpoint
    per step of this call (empty when ``steps`` is empty); ``history``
    recursively copies every given checkpoint and appends the new
    checkpoints; and ``changes`` lists, per step in order, one
    ``[p, finished_ids, retried_ids]`` list per configuration affected
    by that step (configurations in ``progress["configs"]`` order,
    both id lists sorted ascending), so ``changes`` is empty when
    ``steps`` is empty. Every container is recursively copied and
    JSON-compatible (numbers never rounded); the inputs are never
    modified.
    """
    validated = _alert_region_validate_progress(progress)
    current = validated["current"]
    state_sets = [set(group) for group in current]
    configs = validated["configs"]
    universe = state_sets[0] | state_sets[1] | state_sets[2]

    if not isinstance(steps, (list, tuple)):
        raise TypeError(
            f"steps must be a list or tuple, got {type(steps).__name__}"
        )
    normalized_steps: list = []
    for step_index, item in enumerate(steps):
        if not isinstance(item, (list, tuple)):
            raise TypeError(
                f"steps[{step_index}] must be a list or tuple, got "
                f"{type(item).__name__}"
            )
        if len(item) != 2:
            raise ValueError(
                f"steps[{step_index}] must have exactly 2 items "
                f"[finish, retry], got {len(item)}"
            )
        step_finish = _alert_region_normalize_id_list(
            item[0], f"steps[{step_index}][0] (finish)"
        )
        step_retry = _alert_region_normalize_id_list(
            item[1], f"steps[{step_index}][1] (retry)"
        )
        normalized_steps.append((step_finish, step_retry))

    normalized_history = _alert_region_normalize_history(history, universe)

    # Simulate every ordered transfer first; the first failure aborts
    # before any output structure is assembled, keeping the call atomic.
    simulated: list = []
    for step_index, (step_finish, step_retry) in enumerate(normalized_steps):
        finish_set = set(step_finish)
        retry_set = set(step_retry)
        bad_finish = sorted(
            region_id for region_id in finish_set
            if region_id not in state_sets[2]
        )
        if bad_finish:
            raise RuntimeError(
                f"steps[{step_index}] finish ids must be taken from U "
                f"(unlisted regions), bad id(s): {bad_finish}"
            )
        bad_retry = sorted(
            region_id for region_id in retry_set
            if region_id not in state_sets[1]
        )
        if bad_retry:
            raise RuntimeError(
                f"steps[{step_index}] retry ids must be taken from F "
                f"(failed regions), bad id(s): {bad_retry}"
            )
        pre_state = [sorted(group) for group in state_sets]
        state_sets = [
            state_sets[0] | finish_set,
            state_sets[1] - retry_set,
            (state_sets[2] - finish_set) | retry_set,
        ]
        post_state = [sorted(group) for group in state_sets]
        simulated.append(
            (pre_state, post_state, step_finish, step_retry)
        )

    # Chaining is checked against the incoming current state, mirroring
    # alert_region_step's precedence (after step eligibility).
    _alert_region_check_history_chain(normalized_history, current)

    final_state = [sorted(group) for group in state_sets]

    checkpoints: list = []
    changes: list = []
    for pre_state, post_state, step_finish, step_retry in simulated:
        checkpoints.append(
            _alert_region_checkpoint(
                pre_state, post_state, step_finish, step_retry
            )
        )
        changes.append(
            _alert_region_config_changes(
                configs, set(step_finish), set(step_retry)
            )
        )

    history_out = [
        _alert_region_checkpoint(
            pre_state, post_state, step_finish, step_retry
        )
        for pre_state, post_state, step_finish, step_retry
        in normalized_history
    ]
    history_out.extend(checkpoints)

    return {
        "thresholds": _alert_region_copy(validated["thresholds"]),
        "minimums": _alert_region_copy(validated["minimums"]),
        "cursor": len(history),
        "state": final_state,
        "checkpoints": checkpoints,
        "history": history_out,
        "changes": changes,
    }


def receptor_level_quantile(
    H: list[list[float]] | tuple[tuple[float, ...], ...],
    W: list[list[float]] | tuple[tuple[float, ...], ...],
    thresholds: list[float] | tuple[float, ...],
    quantiles: list[float] | tuple[float, ...],
    weights: list[float] | tuple[float, ...] | None = None,
) -> list[list[int]]:
    """Weighted quantiles of the per-receptor health level.

    H: non-empty scenario x receptor matrix of health impacts; both the
        outer container and each row must be a list or tuple, rows must be
        non-empty and share one receptor count; each value finite (negative
        values allowed).
    W: matrix of uncertainties with the same shape as ``H``; each value
        finite and >= 0.
    thresholds: list or tuple of exactly 3 finite, non-negative, strictly
        increasing numbers.
    quantiles: non-empty list or tuple of finite numbers, each in
        ``[0, 1]`` and in non-decreasing order.
    weights: ``None`` (the default) or a K-long list or tuple of finite,
        non-negative entries whose ``fsum`` is positive. With ``None``
        every scenario has weight ``1 / K``; otherwise the weights are
        normalized by their ``fsum``.
    Returns ``Q`` where, with ``sigma = W[k][i]``:

    * ``q[j] = 0.5 * erfc((thresholds[j] - H[k][i]) / (sigma * sqrt(2)))``
      when ``sigma > 0``, otherwise ``1.0`` if ``thresholds[j] <= H[k][i]``
      else ``0.0``;
    * ``p[k][i] = [1 - q0, q0 - q1, q1 - q2, q2]`` holds the probabilities
      of the four health levels for scenario ``k`` at receptor ``i``;
    * ``P[i][r] = fsum(w[k] * p[k][i][r] for k in range(K))`` is the
      weighted probability that receptor ``i`` is at level ``r``;
    * ``Q[m][i]`` is the smallest level ``r`` whose cumulative probability
      ``fsum(P[i][s] for s in range(r + 1))`` is ``>= quantiles[m]``
      (``0`` when ``quantiles[m] == 0``).

    ``Q`` is an M x N list of lists of ints, in ``quantiles`` then
    receptor input order.
    """
    impacts = _validate_matrix("H", H, non_negative=False)
    uncertainties = _validate_matrix("W", W)

    if len(uncertainties) != len(impacts):
        raise ValueError(
            f"H and W must have the same number of scenarios, "
            f"got {len(impacts)} and {len(uncertainties)}"
        )
    n_scenarios = len(impacts)
    n_receptors = len(impacts[0])
    for k, row in enumerate(uncertainties):
        if len(row) != n_receptors:
            raise ValueError(
                f"W[{k}] must have {n_receptors} elements, got {len(row)}"
            )

    if not isinstance(thresholds, (list, tuple)):
        raise TypeError(
            f"thresholds must be a list or tuple, got {type(thresholds).__name__}"
        )
    if len(thresholds) != 3:
        raise ValueError(
            f"thresholds must have exactly 3 elements, got {len(thresholds)}"
        )
    levels = []
    for j, item in enumerate(thresholds):
        if not _is_number(item):
            raise TypeError(
                f"thresholds[{j}] must be an int or float, "
                f"got {type(item).__name__}"
            )
        value = float(item)
        _check_finite(f"thresholds[{j}]", value)
        if value < 0:
            raise ValueError(f"thresholds[{j}] must be >= 0, got {value!r}")
        levels.append(value)
    for j in range(1, 3):
        if not levels[j] > levels[j - 1]:
            raise ValueError(
                f"thresholds must be strictly increasing, got {levels!r}"
            )

def alert_region_recover(records: list | tuple, cursor: int = 0) -> dict:
    """Recover an alert-region execution state from advance records.

    ``records`` must be a non-empty list or tuple whose items are
    seven-key :func:`alert_region_advance` result dicts, with keys
    exactly ``thresholds``, ``minimums``, ``cursor``, ``state``,
    ``checkpoints``, ``history`` and ``changes``. A wrong container or
    item type raises ``TypeError``; an empty sequence, a missing or
    extra key, or a structural, transition or length error raises
    ``ValueError``.

    In every record, ``thresholds`` and ``minimums`` follow the
    :func:`alert_region_step` contract (non-empty lists or tuples of
    non-bool ints of any size, never converted to float, or finite
    floats); ``cursor`` must be a non-bool int ``>= 0``; ``state`` must
    be a ``[D, F, U]`` triple of pairwise disjoint unique non-bool int
    id groups; ``checkpoints`` and ``history`` must be checkpoint lists
    whose items satisfy the finish/retry transition rule; ``changes``
    must be a per-step list of ``[p, finish_ids, retry_ids]`` entries
    with a non-bool int ``p`` and non-bool int id sequences; and the
    lengths must satisfy ``len(history) == cursor + len(checkpoints)``
    and ``len(changes) == len(checkpoints)``.

    Across records the ``thresholds`` and ``minimums`` axis values must
    be equal; each later record's ``cursor`` must equal the previous
    record's ``history`` length and its ``history`` must have the
    previous record's ``history`` as a prefix, or a ``ValueError`` is
    raised. Every record's ``state`` must equal the post-state of the
    last checkpoint of its own ``history`` (a record with an empty
    ``history`` is not checked), or a ``RuntimeError`` is raised.

    ``cursor`` must be a non-bool int within the range of the last
    record's history, ``0 <= cursor <= len(history)``; a wrong type
    raises ``TypeError`` and an out-of-range value raises
    ``ValueError``.

    Returns a dict whose keys in order are ``state``, ``final``,
    ``history``, ``pending`` and ``configs``: ``state`` is the
    post-state of ``history[cursor - 1]`` of the last record (the
    pre-state of its first checkpoint when ``cursor == 0``, or
    ``final`` when the history is empty); ``final`` is the last
    record's ``state``; ``history`` is the last record's ``history``;
    ``pending`` lists the ``[finish, retry]`` pair of every checkpoint
    in ``history[cursor:]``; and ``configs`` holds, in ascending ``p``
    order, one ``[p, finished_ids, retried_ids]`` per configuration
    seen in the records' ``changes``, with the id sequences accumulated
    step by step in record then step order and duplicates kept. Every
    container is recursively copied and JSON-compatible (numbers never
    rounded); the inputs are never modified.
    """
    if not isinstance(records, (list, tuple)):
        raise TypeError(
            f"records must be a list or tuple, got {type(records).__name__}"
        )
    if len(records) == 0:
        raise ValueError("records must not be empty")
    normalized = [
        _alert_region_recover_validate_record(record, index)
        for index, record in enumerate(records)
    ]

    first = normalized[0]
    for index in range(1, len(normalized)):
        previous = normalized[index - 1]
        record = normalized[index]
        if (
            record["thresholds"] != first["thresholds"]
            or record["minimums"] != first["minimums"]
        ):
            raise ValueError(
                f"records[{index}] thresholds/minimums must equal those "
                "of records[0]"
            )
        if record["cursor"] != len(previous["history"]):
            raise ValueError(
                f"records[{index}]['cursor'] must equal "
                f"len(records[{index - 1}]['history']), got "
                f"{record['cursor']} != {len(previous['history'])}"
            )
        prefix_length = len(previous["history"])
        if record["history"][:prefix_length] != previous["history"]:
            raise ValueError(
                f"records[{index}]['history'] must have "
                f"records[{index - 1}]['history'] as a prefix"
            )

    for index, record in enumerate(normalized):
        if record["history"] and record["state"] != record["history"][-1][1]:
            raise RuntimeError(
                f"records[{index}]['state'] does not equal the post-state "
                "of the last checkpoint of its history"
            )

    if not isinstance(cursor, int) or isinstance(cursor, bool):
        raise TypeError(
            f"cursor must be a non-bool int, got {type(cursor).__name__}"
        )
    final_history = normalized[-1]["history"]
    if cursor < 0 or cursor > len(final_history):
        raise ValueError(
            f"cursor must be in 0..{len(final_history)} (the last "
            f"record's history length), got {cursor}"
        )

    final_state = normalized[-1]["state"]
    if not final_history:
        state = [list(group) for group in final_state]
    elif cursor == 0:
        state = [list(group) for group in final_history[0][0]]
    else:
        state = [list(group) for group in final_history[cursor - 1][1]]

    accumulated: dict = {}
    for record in normalized:
        for step_changes in record["changes"]:
            for p_value, finished_ids, retried_ids in step_changes:
                slot = accumulated.setdefault(p_value, [[], []])
                slot[0].extend(finished_ids)
                slot[1].extend(retried_ids)
    configs = [
        [p_value, *accumulated[p_value]]
        for p_value in sorted(accumulated)
    ]

def alert_region_recover(records: list | tuple, cursor: int = 0) -> dict:
    """Recover an alert-region execution state from advance records.

    ``records`` must be a non-empty list or tuple whose items are
    seven-key :func:`alert_region_advance` result dicts, with keys
    exactly ``thresholds``, ``minimums``, ``cursor``, ``state``,
    ``checkpoints``, ``history`` and ``changes``. A wrong container or
    item type raises ``TypeError``; an empty sequence, a missing or
    extra key, or a structural, transition or length error raises
    ``ValueError``.

    In every record, ``thresholds`` and ``minimums`` follow the
    :func:`alert_region_step` contract (non-empty lists or tuples of
    non-bool ints of any size, never converted to float, or finite
    floats); ``cursor`` must be a non-bool int ``>= 0``; ``state`` must
    be a ``[D, F, U]`` triple of pairwise disjoint unique non-bool int
    id groups; ``checkpoints`` and ``history`` must be checkpoint lists
    whose items satisfy the finish/retry transition rule; ``changes``
    must be a per-step list of ``[p, finish_ids, retry_ids]`` entries
    with a non-bool int ``p`` and non-bool int id sequences; and the
    lengths must satisfy ``len(history) == cursor + len(checkpoints)``
    and ``len(changes) == len(checkpoints)``.

    Across records the ``thresholds`` and ``minimums`` axis values must
    be equal; each later record's ``cursor`` must equal the previous
    record's ``history`` length and its ``history`` must have the
    previous record's ``history`` as a prefix, or a ``ValueError`` is
    raised. Every record's ``state`` must equal the post-state of the
    last checkpoint of its own ``history`` (a record with an empty
    ``history`` is not checked), or a ``RuntimeError`` is raised.

    ``cursor`` must be a non-bool int within the range of the last
    record's history, ``0 <= cursor <= len(history)``; a wrong type
    raises ``TypeError`` and an out-of-range value raises
    ``ValueError``.

    Returns a dict whose keys in order are ``state``, ``final``,
    ``history``, ``pending`` and ``configs``: ``state`` is the
    post-state of ``history[cursor - 1]`` of the last record (the
    pre-state of its first checkpoint when ``cursor == 0``, or
    ``final`` when the history is empty); ``final`` is the last
    record's ``state``; ``history`` is the last record's ``history``;
    ``pending`` lists the ``[finish, retry]`` pair of every checkpoint
    in ``history[cursor:]``; and ``configs`` holds, in ascending ``p``
    order, one ``[p, finished_ids, retried_ids]`` per configuration
    seen in the records' ``changes``, with the id sequences accumulated
    step by step in record then step order and duplicates kept. Every
    container is recursively copied and JSON-compatible (numbers never
    rounded); the inputs are never modified.
    """
    if not isinstance(records, (list, tuple)):
        raise TypeError(
            f"records must be a list or tuple, got {type(records).__name__}"
        )
    if len(records) == 0:
        raise ValueError("records must not be empty")
    normalized = [
        _alert_region_recover_validate_record(record, index)
        for index, record in enumerate(records)
    ]

    first = normalized[0]
    for index in range(1, len(normalized)):
        previous = normalized[index - 1]
        record = normalized[index]
        if (
            record["thresholds"] != first["thresholds"]
            or record["minimums"] != first["minimums"]
        ):
            raise ValueError(
                f"records[{index}] thresholds/minimums must equal those "
                "of records[0]"
            )
        if record["cursor"] != len(previous["history"]):
            raise ValueError(
                f"records[{index}]['cursor'] must equal "
                f"len(records[{index - 1}]['history']), got "
                f"{record['cursor']} != {len(previous['history'])}"
            )
        prefix_length = len(previous["history"])
        if record["history"][:prefix_length] != previous["history"]:
            raise ValueError(
                f"records[{index}]['history'] must have "
                f"records[{index - 1}]['history'] as a prefix"
            )

    for index, record in enumerate(normalized):
        if record["history"] and record["state"] != record["history"][-1][1]:
            raise RuntimeError(
                f"records[{index}]['state'] does not equal the post-state "
                "of the last checkpoint of its history"
            )

    if not isinstance(cursor, int) or isinstance(cursor, bool):
        raise TypeError(
            f"cursor must be a non-bool int, got {type(cursor).__name__}"
        )
    final_history = normalized[-1]["history"]
    if cursor < 0 or cursor > len(final_history):
        raise ValueError(
            f"cursor must be in 0..{len(final_history)} (the last "
            f"record's history length), got {cursor}"
        )

    final_state = normalized[-1]["state"]
    if not final_history:
        state = [list(group) for group in final_state]
    elif cursor == 0:
        state = [list(group) for group in final_history[0][0]]
    else:
        state = [list(group) for group in final_history[cursor - 1][1]]

    accumulated: dict = {}
    for record in normalized:
        for step_changes in record["changes"]:
            for p_value, finished_ids, retried_ids in step_changes:
                slot = accumulated.setdefault(p_value, [[], []])
                slot[0].extend(finished_ids)
                slot[1].extend(retried_ids)
    configs = [
        [p_value, *accumulated[p_value]]
        for p_value in sorted(accumulated)
    ]

    return {
        "state": state,
        "final": [list(group) for group in final_state],
        "history": _alert_region_copy(final_history),
        "pending": [
            [list(checkpoint[2]), list(checkpoint[3])]
            for checkpoint in final_history[cursor:]
        ],
        "configs": configs,
    }

lines: - `audit_trend_alert_regions(snapshots, sizes, settings, thresholds, minimums, capacity=10)`：批告警网格上等状态格的四邻接连通区域（仅自 `air_quality.health` 导出，不入包根）。参数契约与异常沿用 `audit_trend_alert_grid` 并原样传播。仅调用一次 `audit_trend_alert_grid` 得 G。格 `[a,b]` 仅与上下左右四邻格相邻，两格在 `G["reports"]` 中对应项列表相等即同状态；按 `(a,b)` 序（a 外层、b 内层）扫描，跳过已归属格，每次泛洪收集所有四邻接可达且同状态的格为一个区域。区域 id 自 0 起按发现序递增，各区域成员坐标按 `(a,b)` 升序。区域项为 `[id,cells,threshold_bounds,minimum_bounds,state]`：`cells` 列出各 `[a,b]` 成员；`threshold_bounds` 取成员 a 下标极值对应的 `G["thresholds"]` 两值，`minimum_bounds` 取成员 b 下标极值对应的 `G["minimums"]` 两值；`state` 为该区域 `[runs,priority]` 状态的递归副本。两个不同区域只要存在四邻接的成员对即产生边 `[小id,大id,fields]`，按 id 对去重并按两 id 升序排列；`fields` 按 `runs`、`priority` 的顺序列出两端区域状态中值不同的位置名。对 G 的 `focus` 项 `[p,c]`，若 p 出现在区域的 `priority` 中则把 c 计入该区域 score；`priority` 每区域一项 `[id,score,成员数]`，按 `(-score,-成员数,id)` 升序。返回键依次为 `thresholds`、`minimums`、`regions`、`adjacency`、`priority` 的 dict：前两值取 G 的同名值，`regions` 按 id 序。不修改输入；全部容器递归复制、JSON 兼容，`None` 保留，数值不舍入
